scene.placeText: a maskmakers' workshop on a little canal of her world's floating capital at candlelit night — walls hung with gilded and painted carnival masks, plumes and silk ribbons, pots of gold leaf and white gesso on the workbench, and a window open onto lantern-lit water and gliding black boats

scene.outfit: a mask-enchantress look fitted to her body — a sleeveless bodice of midnight velvet traced with gold leaf, a short skirt of layered Venetian-red silk edged in raised needle lace, long veil sashes drifting from her hips, a headdress of gilded lace and curling plumes and laced velvet heels
scene.scene: she is the mask-enchantress of the carnival, cradling a white half-mask in both hands at her bench and pressing gold leaf onto its brow, each touch waking a faint golden light in it so that whoever wears it will have a new face for the night

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Italian woman — the personification of Venice — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Venice as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a maskmakers' workshop on a little canal of her world's floating capital at candlelit night — walls hung with gilded and painted carnival masks, plumes and silk ribbons, pots of gold leaf and white gesso on the workbench, and a window open onto lantern-lit water and gliding black boats
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a mask-enchantress look fitted to her body — a sleeveless bodice of midnight velvet traced with gold leaf, a short skirt of layered Venetian-red silk edged in raised needle lace, long veil sashes drifting from her hips, a headdress of gilded lace and curling plumes and laced velvet heels, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she holds a white carnival half-mask half-covered in gold leaf, a curl of gold leaf lifting from its brow in both hands in front of her — her own right hand holds one side, her own left hand holds the other side.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.
Scene note: she is the mask-enchantress of the carnival, cradling a white half-mask in both hands at her bench and pressing gold leaf onto its brow, each touch waking a faint golden light in it so that whoever wears it will have a new face for the night

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a gilded half-mask of the carnival on a slender gold baton — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.
